summary: Tested Loan Renewal / Repeat Loan feature. Backend API (GET /api/paid-loans/{client_id}/latest) works correctly. Frontend add-loan page properly shows renewal mode with pre-filled form fields when navigated with renew=true parameter. Fixed a bug in the frontend code where the renewal feature wasn't triggering due to param parsing and falsy value handling.

issues: 'Renew Loan' and 'Setup Loan' buttons only appear for REGISTERED clients. Test client (AUTO_ARCHIVE_TEST) has loan history but is NOT registered, so buttons don't appear. This is a design choice - Quick Actions section only shows for registered devices.

action_items: Consider: If Renew Loan button should appear for unregistered clients too, move it outside the is_registered conditional block in client-details.tsx (~line 1504)
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed bug: useLocalSearchParams may return params in different formats. Added Array.isArray check for renew param.
Fixed bug: Original code used truthy checks (if data.loan_amount) which failed for values of 0. Changed to explicit null/undefined checks.
seed_data_creation: Used existing test client AUTO_ARCHIVE_TEST (83e8286a-92f8-4081-989b-88bba77bf877) which has archived loan data
context_for_next_testing_agent: Loan renewal feature is working. The add-loan page at /admin/add-loan?clientId=X&renew=true now correctly shows 'Uuenda laenu' title, green renewal banner, and pre-fills loan_amount, interest_rate, and due_date from the client's latest archived loan. Backend endpoint GET /api/paid-loans/{client_id}/latest returns proper data. Note: Renew Loan button in client-details only shows for registered clients - this is by design but may need discussion.

backend_get_latest_paid_loan.details: GET /api/paid-loans/{client_id}/latest returns loan_amount, interest_rate, loan_tenure_months correctly

backend_404_no_archived_loans.details: Returns 404 with 'No archived loans found for this client' when client has no archived loans

frontend_title_change.details: Page title changes to 'Uuenda laenu' (Estonian) when renew=true

frontend_renewal_banner.details: Green banner with data-testid='renewal-banner' shows message 'Eelmise laenu andmed on eeltäidetud. Muutke vajadusel.'

frontend_form_prefill.details: loan_amount=100, interest_rate=0, due_date=03/16/2026 (1 month from today) correctly pre-filled from archived loan

client_details_renew_button.details: Button exists with correct data-testid='renew-loan-btn' but only shows for registered clients. Test client has loan history but is unregistered.

client_details_setup_button.details: Button exists with correct data-testid='setup-loan-btn' but only shows for registered clients without loan history.

bugs_fixed.issue: Renewal useEffect not triggering - renew param comparison was strict string equality
bugs_fixed.fix: Added Array.isArray check: const isRenewMode = renew === 'true' || (Array.isArray(renew) && renew[0] === 'true')

bugs_fixed.issue: interest_rate=0 not being set because truthy check (if data.interest_rate) fails for 0
bugs_fixed.fix: Changed to explicit null/undefined checks: if (data.interest_rate !== undefined && data.interest_rate !== null)
